title: EXP-083 - Hello World Part 5 Section 6a: Create the Missing FX_Orders Caption Strings and Check Joined and Derived Values at Runtime
objective: Follow hello-world-pt5.md Section 6 steps 1, 2 and 4 (08:15-10:38), adapted to FX_ names. In the Web Designer (User scope) open the FX_Orders Form rebuilt in EXP-082 and create the three missing caption strings through the Caption ellipsis procedure of EXP-072: FX_sCustomerName = Customer Name (on FX_CusNameStatic); FX_sItemDescription = Item Description (on FX_ItmsDescriptionStatic); FX_sOrderTotal = Order Total (on FX_DerOrderTotalStatic). Perform one Designer Save, close and reopen the Form once and verify the captions. Then open FX_Orders in the Web Client read-only, load the two existing orders with one blank-criteria query and verify the joined and derived values: Order Number 1, Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00; Order Number 2, Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99. The existing orders stand in for the tutorial's new order; no record is added or changed. The picture component is EXP-084. Findings are observed only.

in_scope: Read AGENTS.md, docs/mongoose/transcripts/hello-world-pt5.md Section 6 (08:15-10:38), the EXP-082 record (the 31 FX_Orders components, Static names, caption readings and raw string IDs; the Form menu recent-forms route), the EXP-072 and EXP-076 records (Caption ellipsis string creation: the exact "String <ID> does not exist. Create it?" prompt, Tab commit of the String Value before OK, Edit > String readback), the EXP-078 record (runtime blank-criteria query; Filter in Place on reopen) and the EXP-081 record (the Label String IDs) before browser interaction.
Create or update only experiments/EXP-083-hello-world-part-5-section-6a-fx-orders-strings-and-runtime-check.md and evidence/EXP-083/ documentation and evidence files.
Record the worker-written-file inventory and a cumulative browser action audit with exact counts.

Use the existing authenticated session without refresh, restart or configuration change. If it expires, follow the worker-preamble session-expiry procedure once and end the task; never sign in inside the portal's embedded app frame (refused, EXP-080-R2) but use the procedure's top-level portal navigation. If the Web Designer tab shows an expiry or sign-in, record it and stop the task for the coordinator. List the browser tabs before the first tab selection. Answer any prompt within the same task; never leave a prompt open across tasks (EXP-082 timeout).

Preflight and gates: the Designer is in User scope and clean. In the Designer Edit > String view confirm FX_sCustomerName, FX_sItemDescription and FX_sOrderTotal absent and FX_sAddress = Address present (positive control), then cancel. Open FX_Orders once through the Form menu recent-forms entry (or Select Form) and record identity, scope and the Caption of the three target Static components (expected the raw IDs above).

Strings: for each target in the order above, select its Static component in the Details > Components grid, open the Caption ellipsis once, answer Yes once only to the exact "String <ID> does not exist. Create it?" prompt for that ID, replace the generated String Value with the exact value, commit the cell with Tab, verify, then press OK. Never edit a Caption reference itself and never touch another component.
Verify the three new strings in the Edit > String read-only view (exact IDs and values), then cancel.
Perform exactly one Designer Save and record the native response and the clean state.

Close the clean FX_Orders Designer Form once through its Form-tab control and reopen it once through the Form menu recent-forms entry; verify the canvas and the Components grid show Customer Name, Item Description and Order Total, and that the 31 components are otherwise unchanged.

Runtime (read-only): in the Web Client open FX_Orders once through Form > Open > Select Form; record the mode; switch to Filter in Place if the status bar shows another mode, leave every criterion blank and press F4 once. Verify exactly two orders and, for each, every field: Order Number 1, Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00; Order Number 2, Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99; record what the FX_ItmsPicture field shows. Move between the two orders only by clicking their row-number cells. Do not type into any field, choose list values, press New or Save.
Close the runtime FX_Orders Form once at the end; if a close prompt asks to save a new record, answer No once and record it.
Capture screenshots of the gates, each string dialog before OK, the Edit > String readback, the Save, the reopened Form, the runtime after F4 and each order.
Record any blocker after at most one fresh untargeted snapshot and one corrected visible inspection. Classify findings as observed only.

Never change the FX_Orders IDO, its properties, a property class, SQL objects or runtime data.

Three strings created through the Caption ellipsis, one Yes each to the exact prompt, values committed with Tab before OK: FX_sCustomerName = Customer Name (on FX_CusNameStatic); FX_sItemDescription = Item Description (on FX_ItmsDescriptionStatic); FX_sOrderTotal = Order Total (on FX_DerOrderTotalStatic); Edit > String readback exact. Evidence: dialog and readback screenshots.

Exactly one Designer Save with its native response; the clean Form closed once and reopened once; captions Customer Name, Item Description and Order Total shown; the 31 components otherwise unchanged. Evidence: Save and reopen screenshots.

Runtime: one blank-criteria query shows exactly two orders with Order Number 1, Customer ID FX001, Customer Name Factory test one, Address 1 Factory Street, Item dumbbell, Item Description 45 pound iron, Cost 45.00, Count 2, Order Total 90.00 and Order Number 2, Customer ID FX002, Customer Name Factory test two, Address 2 Factory Street, Item eggs, Item Description cage free, Cost 6.99, Count 1, Order Total 6.99; the FX_ItmsPicture display recorded; nothing typed or saved; the runtime Form closed once. Evidence: one screenshot per order.

The final EXP-083 report gives decisive evidence for AC-1 to AC-4, the complete action audit with exact counts (strings 3, prompt Yes 3, OK 3, Designer Save 1, Designer close/reopen 1, runtime open 1, F4 1, runtime close 1, zero component edits, zero runtime edits, zero IDO changes, zero checkout actions, re-login count), the worker-written-file inventory and the final state.
